title: test-ci skill
description: Tiered CI with gate, quarantine, diff mutation, probation runs; GitHub and GitLab templates.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Approvals sourced from the review record for R4/R5

finalSummary: test-ci skill with GitHub Actions and GitLab templates (PR/main/nightly tiers, quarantine, gate, diff mutation, probation record). Evidence: both templates parse with yaml.safe_load; gate judges PRs by the base ref's policy and baseline (test_a_change_cannot_loosen_its_own_gate); approvals come from gh pr view reviews into TMX_PR_APPROVERS (R5 tests).
